text: So...what? Are we under Area Zero or something?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_03
text:
Yes! According to my data, our current position
is far deeper than where we last were!\c
Could the elevator have taken us even further
down than its previous destination?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_sister_02
text: Man, Area Zero was already a lot to take in...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0260_sister_03
text: I don’t think anything’s gonna surprise me at this\npoint, no matter what we run into.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0260_brother_02
text: What’s...all this stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0260_sister_04
text: What are desks doing down here?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_05
text: Oh my... Oh my, this is...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_06

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_07

text:

and there slumbers Terapagos, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]the hidden[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]

label: sdc02_0260_book_01b
text:
In this cavern, I have witnessed the Terastal
phenomenon occurring in a way I’ve never seen
aboveground—Terastallization that appears to
hold the power of every known type. I have
dubbed this Tera Type the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Stellar[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] type for now.

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_09
text: Brilliant! Absolutely marvelous! To think there was\nso much that Heath didn’t write about![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_10
text: These documents are a veritable treasure trove!\nAnd we’ve only just begun our expedition![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_sister_05
text: I dunno how she can get so excited in a bizarre\nplace like this...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0260_brother_03
text: The Legendary Pokémon Terapagos... That’s the\nhidden treasure...of Area Zero...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0260_brother_04
text: C’mon, let’s hurry up and go further in.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_11
text: I still haven’t gotten my fill of these documents,\nbut...OK! Let’s go![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_bbteacher_12
text: It would be best to discover the truth with our\nown eyes, after all![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0260_sister_06
text: Let’s keep moving. Stay on guard, everyone...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
